positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer for Google TV iOS client. Team lead and architect for interaction logging, analytics, and experiment infrastructure. Responsible for driving app quality improvements, including stability, media playback Quality of Experience (QoE), and other key user features.


Previously software engineer for the Play Movies living room clients. Responsible for improving QoE on living room devices from Samsung, LG, and Roku. I was team lead for logging and analytics and instrumental in a complete rebuild of the Google Play Movies app for Roku in Brightscript.

positions.title: Technology Intern
positions.description:
Developing web application utilizing Nodejs, Casperjs, and the Google Cloud platform:

 - Developed a Nodejs server cluster for handling tasks coming as requests and distributing the tasks to the cluster of Casperjs nodes within the compute engine instance
 
- Developed a Casperjs cluster for distribution of web crawling and data mining tasks within the compute engine instance

 - Wrote a program using google's Nodejs client api which periodically checks pull queue for new tasks to lease, then processes and routes tasks to the Nodejs cluster. 

 - Created snapshot and wrote a startup script which updates the codebase then starts up necessary services. for easy reboot and start up of fresh compute engine instances upon need. 

 - Integrated google's orchestrator example into the app engine application to allow for monitoring and scaling of compute engine instances as needed.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Executed functional testing, system testing, and final QA for HighVIEW, a document and
workflow management technology.

Revised and updated functional test cases for redaction tool to
promote more efficient testing and modification of test document for
newly developed features.

Fixed bugs and implemented new features for the image redaction tool including modifying .NET services and developing a Java based approach for encoding, decoding, splitting, and merging multi-page TIF’s

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Unit Tested and debugged core project code

Wrote and tested cross-platform gesture engine for use with Android and IOS devices

Tweaked the engine to maximize uniformity in gesture behavior between Android and IOS devices.

positions.title: Student Research Assistant
positions.description: Developed a graph visualization tool to be used in studies.

honors.title: Encore Achiever Award
honors.description: Presented to those employees who receive client letters of commendation and appreciation detailing exceptional service and outstanding performance over and above normal job duties.
honors.issuer: Issued by CACI International Inc. · Mar 2012
